description: Every BrowserWindow. Mirrors a context-isolated, sandboxed Electron renderer: it can only exchange IPC messages with the main window, plus webFrame zoom and closing its own window (window.close()) and dragging it from `-webkit-app-region: drag` areas. ipcRenderer.sendSync and window configuration go through tauri-plugin-electron's URI scheme, which needs no permission. Add permissions here if your renderers call other APIs directly.
